The plate is roughly 345 px wide in the image. If it is a dinner plate of about 26 cm, that gives about 0.075 cm per px, or roughly 13 px per cm.

The five small round patties are each about 55 px across, so about 4 cm. I'd estimate each is about 1.5 cm thick. That gives a volume of about 3.14 × 4 cm × 1.5 cm ≈ 19 cm³, or roughly 15–19 g per patty at a density near 0.85 g/cm³. Five patties come to about 80 g.

They look like baked vegetable or falafel-type bites. I'll use about 200 kcal per 100 g.
